description: Source embeddings of the fixture talks, sparse: each row lists [index, value] pairs and every other component of the 384 is 0. All three are unit vectors. Expected int8 rows: 1001 -> [127 at 0], 1002 -> [127 at 1], 1003 -> [95 at 0, -127 at 1] (0.6 x 127/0.8 = 95.25 rounds to 95). Cosines: 1001-1002 = 0, 1001-1003 = 95/sqrt(95^2+127^2) = 0.5990, 1002-1003 = -127/sqrt(95^2+127^2) = -0.8008.
